data.standardized_narrative: The report provides a gross claims outstanding (claims reserves) balance at the opening of the year of approximately GBP 9.513m (balance at 1 January). No explicit gross prior-year reserve movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) is clearly stated in the available pages; a gross prior-year development figure could not be identified. Gross written premium for the year is shown as GBP 45.609m. No claims development triangle or explicit gross prior-year strengthening/release amount was located in the available pages.
data.data_quality_notes: Document images were partially legible. Opening gross claims outstanding was read from the Technical Provisions table (balance at 1 January) as 9,513 (thousands)  9.513m. I could not find a clear, labelled gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' or a gross claims development triangle in the supplied pages. Some notes and tables were difficult to read and the report contains multiple tables (36-month and 12-month formats) which increased ambiguity. Where gross figures were not available, I have not substituted net figures. Users should verify against the original PDF for precise prior-year movement and a detailed segmental premium breakdown.
